definitions.short: commotion , restlessness (of a horse), crash (of thunder), disquiet , anger
definitions.full: H7267. rogez רֹ֫גֶז noun masculine Job 3:26 agitation, excitement, raging ; — ׳ר absolute Hab 3:2 +, construct Job 37:2 ; suffix רָנְזֶךָ֑ Isa 14:3 ; — raging Job 3:17 ; disquiet, turmoil Isa 14:3 ; Job 3:26 ; 14:1 ; raging, wrath Hab 3:2 ; ׳ר קֹלוֺ Job 37:2 rumbling of his voice (i.e. thunder); of excitement of warhorse, וְרֹגֶּז בְּרַעַשׁ 39:24 .
